div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
NODAL BLOCK (above the His)
1st degree - Mobitz I (Wenckebach)
NARROW QRS - atropine WORKS
junctional escape 40-60, reliable
Inferior MI - vagal - AV nodal drugs

div.style: color: rgb(254, 205, 211) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
INFRANODAL BLOCK (His or below)
Mobitz II - high-grade - most CHB
WIDE QRS - atropine FAILS or WORSENS
ventricular escape 20-40, unreliable
Anterior MI - Lev/Lenegre - needs a wire
